title: Judicial Committee of the Privy Council: Printed Cases in Indian and Colonial Appeals and Printed Papers in Appeals
summary: This series contains: 'Printed Cases in Indian and Colonial Appeals' (1792 to 1878), including appeals from the Crown Dependencies (Guernsey, Jersey and the Isle of Man); 'Printed Papers in Appeals' (1873 to 2008).
